claims.value: Le Noble places the first British crossings in the night of 11–12 May; Oman describes Wellesley deciding around high noon. The clocks remain disputed.
claims.rationale: Opposed retrospective accounts, not a reconciled event clock; Oman’s negligence language is his judgment. English rendering (ours): "The British began crossing during the night of 11–12; [Oman] they seemed asleep at high noon, encouraging him."
